task: Pick up the mug from the table and place it on the saucer.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the mug, and its tip is about 5 cm away from the mug.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the mug, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the mug and about 10 cm away from the saucer.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the mug so that it now rests on the saucer.
